name: Shiranagi Kyouko
source:
The stoic weirdo of the arts club. She never seems surprised at anything.

She doesn't talk about it often at school, but she loves playing zombie and crime videogames.
It probably plays a role on why she loves horror and occult stuff.

She's got an older sister, who influenced her in both good and bad ways.

It's often impossible to tell what she's thinking, but she likes her friends.

"World domination"
